title: Elite area
wikitext:
'''Elite areas''' (aka '''non-instanced dungeons''', '''micro dungeons''', and '''half dungeons''') are areas in a non-instanced zone full of [[elite creature]]s. These usually require a [[group]] to complete and are often the focus of group [[quests]].

With the current rarity of elite mobs, the terms mentioned above could be used to refer to any non-instanced questing area that is separated from its surroundings (caves, crypts, buildings, etc).

Current non-instanced dungeons include, by zone:
